title: Not a good fit for our kids
text:
I canceled our subscribtion after the last 3 deliveries failed to meet our expectations. My kids turn 7, soon, so well within the age group 5-7, but a talking microscope rated 4+ and a car model rated 4+do not inspire my kids.
We did like the Robotics Set and the Magic Engineering Schoolbus. That is 2 out of 5.
label: negative
